scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix apps/storefront install --include=dev && npm --prefix apps/admin-panel install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/storefront run build && npm --prefix apps/admin-panel run build
scripts.build:storefront: npm --prefix apps/storefront install --include=dev && npm --prefix apps/storefront run build
scripts.build:admin: npm --prefix apps/admin-panel install --include=dev && npm --prefix apps/admin-panel run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,storefront,admin" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:storefront" "npm run dev:admin"
